abstract: Evaluates structural integrity, seismic safety ratings, and structural wind resistance records for public facilities
system_message:
You are the Structural safety engineer (STR), responsible for evaluating structural integrity, seismic safety ratings, and structural wind resistance records for public facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Structural wind resistance（WIND）
information_points.content:
STR-WIND-VL5：For the Bolinas Lagoon Regional Recreation Center, the external roof and wall cladding assembly is rated for a maximum design gust velocity of 140 km/h.
STR-WIND-9GG：For the Inverness Ridge Civic Gymnasium, the external roof and wall cladding assembly demonstrates a maximum design gust velocity of 120 km/h.
STR-WIND-MZF：For the Point Reyes Coastal Community Pavilion, the external roof and wall cladding assembly has a maximum design gust velocity of 160 km/h.

information_points.title: Evaluates structural integrity, seismic safety ratings, and structural wind resistance records for public facilities（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STR-SEIS-GAK：For the Point Reyes Coastal Community Pavilion, the primary shelter structural frame possesses valid seismic structural compliance certification under California Building Code Risk Category IV seismic performance standards.
STR-SEIS-F41：For the Bolinas Lagoon Regional Recreation Center, the primary shelter structural frame maintains valid seismic structural compliance certification meeting California Building Code Risk Category IV seismic performance standards.
STR-SEIS-W7V：For the Inverness Ridge Civic Gymnasium, the primary shelter structural frame does not hold seismic structural compliance certification under California Building Code Risk Category IV seismic performance standards.
